title: publication-bias-v1 player output, task set v2
description: The publication-bias statistics for one meta-analytic dataset, one block per method. There is no verdict: v2 scores whether each statistic is computed correctly, not whether the player concludes the set is biased. Every block and every field is optional; a statistic that is omitted scores 0 for that statistic, exactly as a wrong one does, so omitting is never cheaper than computing. Never send null. The schema checks SHAPE only (which keys, numeric types); it sets no value ranges. An impossible value — a p-value above 1, a Bayes factor of 0, a negative count — is scored 0 for that one statistic by the scorer, exactly like any other wrong value, rather than voiding the player's other statistics.

egger.description: Egger's regression test: weighted least squares of yi on sei with weights 1/sei^2 (multiplicative error, as lm). p is the two-sided t-test of the sei slope on k-2 df.

begg.description: Begg & Mazumdar rank correlation: Kendall's tau between (yi - theta_FE)/sqrt(vi - 1/sum(1/vi)) and vi, with its exact two-sided p (metafor::ranktest).

trimfill.description: Duval & Tweedie trim-and-fill on the REML random-effects model, L0 estimator, side chosen automatically (metafor::trimfill defaults).

pet.description: PET: the intercept of the weighted least squares regression of yi on sei (weights 1/sei^2).

peese.description: PEESE: the intercept of the weighted least squares regression of yi on sei^2 (weights 1/sei^2).

three_psm.description: Three-parameter selection model: random effects, one step at one-sided p = .025, fitted by maximum likelihood (metafor::selmodel type = 'stepfun'). estimate = adjusted mean effect; lrt_p = likelihood-ratio test of the selection model against the unadjusted model.

robma.description: Robust Bayesian meta-analysis with the RoBMA R package's default ensemble (RoBMA-PSMA). bf_bias = inclusion Bayes factor for the publication-bias component; mu = model-averaged posterior mean of the effect.
